name: .dat v1 writer (TypeScript)
notes: Envelope: 4-byte magic 'HUSH'; int32 little-endian version 1; 16-byte salt; 12-byte nonce; AES-256-GCM ciphertext (128-bit tag) of UTF-8 JSON. Key: PBKDF2-SHA256 100000 iterations, password = UTF-8 bytes. Payload shape: PortableCredentials (ProfileName, PublicSigningAddress, PrivateSigningKey, PublicEncryptAddress, PrivateEncryptKey, IsPublic, Mnemonic string|null). Mutually compatible with P-05.
